# TASK-022 Report-ready email

Status: ready

Outcome: when a report finishes, the shop's customers get a "your report is ready" email, as the ruling cited below allows.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0009
  Path           docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000

## Agent note (blocked, not implemented)

Stopped before building. The cited digest does not match the ruling file.
- Cited:    sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b000000
- Computed: sha256:0b26c259cddbf3c16afa22c98034ae0b627b186344f972431cbac28a5b6ea0ca
  (example/mira-decisions at 1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c, docs/adr/0009-no-new-kind-of-customer-message-without-approval.md)

As read, ADR 0009 is Accepted and says no new kind of customer message (email, SMS, push) goes out until Mira has approved that kind of message in the decision log. I found no approval of a "report ready" email there. So the ruling does not "allow" this email as the task claims; it requires Mira's approval first.
Needed: the planning agent re-issues the reference with the right digest, and Mira approves this kind of message in mira-decisions.
